#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

class Modulo {
public:
    const long mod;

    Modulo(long mod) : mod(mod) {}

    long plus(long a, long b) {
        long c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) {
            c -= mod;
        }
        return c;
    }

    long minus(long a, long b) {
        long c = a - b;
        if (c < 0) {
            c += mod;
        }
        return c;
    }

    long times(long a, long b) {
        return a * b % mod;
    }

    long div(long a, long b) {
        return times(a, pow(b, mod - 2));
    }

    long pow(long a, long b) {
        long c = 1;

        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) > 0) {
                c = c * a % mod;
            }
            a = a * a % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }

        return c;
    }

    long combination(int n, int k) {
        return div(factorial(n), times(factorial(k), factorial(n - k)));
    }

    long combination(int n, int k, vector<long>& factorials) {
        return div(factorials[n], times(factorials[k], factorials[n - k]));
    }

    long factorial(int n) {
        long f = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f = f * i % mod;
        }
        return f;
    }

    vector<long> factorials(int n) {
        vector<long> f(n + 1);
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        return f;
    }

private:
    long pow(long a, long b) {
        long c = 1;

        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) > 0) {
                c = c * a;
            }
            a = a * a;
            b >>= 1;
        }

        return c;
    }
};

class FastReader {
public:
    string next() {
        string str;
        cin >> str;
        return str;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int num;
        cin >> num;
        return num;
    }

    long nextLong() {
        long num;
        cin >> num;
        return num;
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        double num;
        cin >> num;
        return num;
    }
};

class FastWriter {
public:
    FastWriter() {}

    void print(long num) {
        cout << num;
    }

    void println(long num) {
        cout << num << endl;
    }

    void print(string str) {
        cout << str;
    }

    void println(string str) {
        cout << str << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader in;
    FastWriter out;

    int t = 1;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        solve(in, out);
    }

    out.println();
    out.flush();

    return 0;
}

void solve(FastReader& in, FastWriter& out) {
    int n = in.nextInt();
    long kt = in.nextLong();

    if (kt >= n) {
        out.println(0);
        return;
    }

    int k = (int)kt;
    Modulo mod(998244353);
    vector<long> facts = mod.factorials(n);

    long ans = 0;
    int c = n - k;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
        long t = mod.times(mod.combination(c, i, facts), mod.pow(c - i, n));
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            ans = mod.plus(ans, t);
        } else {
            ans = mod.minus(ans, t);
        }
    }
    ans = mod.times(ans, mod.combination(n, n - k, facts));

    if (k > 0) ans = mod.times(ans, 2);
    out.println(ans);
}
